review_method: Primary assistant review of evidence bodies, reconstruction checks and the observed regression; no automated answer-success or physics score.
implemented: Hash-bound persisted EvidenceBlock records preserve full source-block bodies, release, source hash, DOM XPath and anchor.

Text projections generate tokenizer-bounded children with title/heading/definition-entry context included. Child spans reconstruct the entire searchable projection without gaps or overlap; offsets are explicitly projection characters, not HTML byte offsets.
BM25 search_passages returns raw passage ranking through a public method; the existing search method retains page deduplication and ranking behavior.
Ranked child IDs resolve to full parent blocks, deduplicating the same parent after ranking while allowing different parents from the same page.

The pilot connects real persisted Chroma Dense, BM25, fixed local Cross-Encoder, parent-store reopening and the existing shared-budget evidence renderer. This is not registered as an Agent tool profile.

sample_and_storage.deferred_behavior: All deferred source bodies remain stored with explicit status; no children are generated for them. This is a coverage limitation, not implemented formula/table/list retrieval.
sample_and_storage.manifest_boundary: Dedicated pilot manifests are intentionally not the product IndexManifest schema; the ordinary document tool cannot silently treat child records as a complete supported index.

comparison_limits: Both small indices use exactly the same twelve source pages, the same existing encoder and the same raw Dense20/BM2520 plus fixed reranker recipe. They differ in parser output, coverage, record identity and parent expansion, not only one chunk-size parameter.
The corpus is much smaller than either full historical index. Do not attribute differences against full-index reports to this design or claim full-corpus recall improvements.
Fourteen exposed development queries per arm produce twenty-eight runs; the known MESHING PREDICTOR cutoff is an added development probe, not held-out.
No default index, production document parser, active query formulation or Agent tool was switched. The additive BM25 passage API does not change default search results.

content_findings.finding: The candidate returns the full Riks method paragraph first, including simultaneous load/displacement solution and arc length, with product names in correct position. It also returns proportional-loading context; not all LPF/dead-load requirements are covered by this small corpus or Top-4.

The candidate's actual rank-3 returned parent contains the full increment-adjustment rule, exception list and after-time-point fallback with no delivery truncation. Parent reconstruction is confirmed, not merely a direct fixture.

The candidate actually retrieves the MESHING PREDICTOR parent first and returns both Standard/Explicit interpretations, including the original-mesh tail lost by the old exact record. This parent is currently serialized DefinitionXML, so raw evidence remains more verbose than a polished reading view.

The returned parents include pressure indeterminacy, independently interpolated pressure and scoped incompressibility qualifications. This is more coherent evidence, but does not establish general element-selection correctness.
A complete source paragraph explaining one-point integration, zero computed strain and uncontrolled distortion is returned first. The block also retains the mesh/mitigation qualification.
The full quasi-static mass-scaling paragraph is returned first, retaining the inertial-force and solution-change qualifications together.

Regression relative to this pilot control: parameter definitions occupy the candidate Top-4 instead of the explanatory paragraph. Follow-up read-only inspection shows the correct 905-character parent was already in the candidate pool: raw Dense rank 13 and BM25 rank 7; Cross-Encoder puts its child at rank 5, logit 2.2375528812408447. This failure is final selection, not missing source or token truncation. No K/weight/model tuning was performed afterward.

The candidate prefers load-distribution and uniform-coupling material and does not directly return the clean rigidity-versus-deformation comparison. The control has useful comparison context. Whole-parent storage does not guarantee selecting the right parent.
The zero out-of-plane strain paragraph is complete, but the separate thickness-stress example is not returned. A complete paragraph is not a complete answer across paragraphs.

The result contains definitions and untied-node qualifications but emphasizes special constraint details over a concise permanent-bond explanation. The introductory preservation work alone does not ensure the main fact is selected.

The Scripting Reference member is outside this corpus, and the BC query remains unsatisfied by the returned Riks context. Parent-child retrieval cannot manufacture an absent source or guarantee a missing requirement is selected.

verification.ruff_and_basedpyright: passed for changed retrieval modules and tests
verification.latency_scope: Single local CPU execution per exposed query, retrieval/scoring/rendering inside the pilot; not production p95 or an Agent latency claim.

decision: Keep the parent-child implementation and pilot as a working evidence-preservation path, but do not promote the pilot index to the product default. RAG is not finished: final evidence selection still has regressions, deferred structured coverage needs its own representation work, and source-block completeness is not answer completeness. Preserve these failures rather than changing K or claims to make this batch pass.
